concept: Tags: enforce a required tag via SCP and aws:RequestTag
tests: How to prevent creating resources without the required CostCenter tag across the whole organization.
expected: SCP/IAM policy with Deny if aws:RequestTag/CostCenter is missing (Null condition). Triggers: "enforce tag", "prevent creation otherwise", "across the organization".
why_not: Budgets and Cost Explorer only show spend; CloudWatch alarms monitor metrics — none of them block creation.
